description: You are logged into Emoncms at http://localhost as the admin user (username: admin, password: admin). Navigate to the Feeds page and create a new PHPFina feed with the following settings: Name = 'Boiler Power', Tag = 'heat', Unit = 'W', Engine = PHPFina, Interval = 10 seconds. Save the feed. The new feed should appear in the feeds list when done.
